scripts.dev: yarn dev:setup && concurrently -k -n api,frontend -c blue,green "yarn dev:api" "yarn dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:db:wait: sh -c 'until docker compose exec -T db pg_isready -U ${POSTGRES_USER:-campaign} -d ${POSTGRES_DB:-campaign_manager}; do sleep 2; done'
scripts.dev:setup: yarn dev:db && yarn dev:db:wait && yarn db:migrate
